question: does the land this plan protects still exist on the ground
method: Sentinel-2 L2A post-monsoon (10-01 to 12-20) median NDVI inside each traced polygon, [2019, 2020, 2021] baseline against 2025, SCL cloud screening at 55% clear, Sentinel-1 VV/VH for structure
caveat: Sites are recovered from a picture placed on the ground to about 200 m. These are places to inspect, not measurements, and no verdict here is a finding of a violation.
fragile_note: Sites whose interior is narrower than the 200 m placement error are shown but not counted: a small registration shift changes which ground is inside the polygon.
